title: Universal boundedness: existence of one bounded etale cover versus boundedness on every affine etale morphism

standard_prerequisites.name: Etale morphisms are open
standard_prerequisites.use: The etale maps q_i are open, so their images cover U.

standard_prerequisites.name: Bounded fibres over quasi-compact source
standard_prerequisites.use: Fibres of p_{i_j} over the quasi-compact opens are universally bounded.

standard_prerequisites.name: Composition of universal boundedness
standard_prerequisites.use: Lifts boundedness from W_j -> U_{i_j} to W_j -> X.

standard_prerequisites.name: Permanence under etale surjection
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers the bound from the coproduct cover to U -> X.

core_obligations: (1) implies (2): finitely many etale opens W_j of U x_X U_{i_j} surject onto U (quasi-compactness of U).
Boundedness of p_{i_j} over the W_j by the quasi-finite boundedness lemma; compose to W_j -> X.
The coproduct cover of U is etale surjective; apply the permanence lemma to bound the fibres of U -> X.
proof_roadmap: Finite subcover extraction; per-piece boundedness; composition; permanence finish.
difficulty_reason: A four-step reassembly; each step is a named lemma applied to an explicit finite cover.
